messages:
Anna (Product): Kicking off discussion on the function-invoke schema priority. We need a minimal viable spec for launch + a clear list of stretch goals. Quick asks from customers: typed tool inputs, streaming tool outputs, and consistent error metadata.
Sam (Eng-Platform): +1. Can we aim minimal = synchronous call with structured JSON args + typed schema validation, and stretch = streaming & incremental results?
Maya (Eng-ML): For runtime perf we should allow callers to pass an argument that indicates whether the tool is idempotent/side-effect-free. It affects retries and batching.
Oliver (DevEx): Also want a simple example for docs and one-liner SDK helpers. Most users copy-paste examples.
Anna (Product): Proposed Launch Criteria: 1) API accepts tool definitions with input schema (JSON Schema subset), 2) LLM can emit a call message referencing tool id + args, 3) Redwood executes tool and returns a result message with result and status, 4) telemetry for call duration and success/failure, 5) docs + example SDK snippets.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Implementation notes: tool manifest shape (minimal):
```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "inputs": { "type": "object", "properties": { /* JSON Schema subset */ } },
  "outputs": { "type": "object" }
}
```
We validate inputs at call time, reject with structured error if invalid.
Maya (Eng-ML): Important: validator must be configurable per-customer: allow strict vs permissive. Some prod apps will want strict rejection, others want best-effort.
Oliver (DevEx): SDK example (pseudocode):
```js
const call = await client.chat.callFunction({model, toolId, args});
if(call.status === 'ok') console.log(call.result);
```
Keep it tiny for launch.
Sam (Eng-Platform): On message format: LLM -> platform should use: `{ "type":"tool_call", "tool_id":"id", "args":{...} }`. Platform -> client: `{ "type":"tool_result", "tool_id":"id", "status":"ok|error|timeout", "payload":{...}, "error":{ "code":"", "message":"" } }`
Anna (Product): Scope negotiation: customers requested function chaining (LLM calls tool A, then B). For launch we should support single-call semantics and plan chaining as v1.1. Agreed?
Maya (Eng-ML): Agreed. Chaining needs robust caching and token accounting; blocks launch timeline.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Streaming: stretch. Implement a streaming frame envelope so we can stream result payload and incremental logs. Proposal for stretch frames: `{ "frame_type":"result_chunk|log|meta", "payload":"...", "seq":n }`.
Oliver (DevEx): Docs examples must show both sync and streaming responses. Also show error codes and recommended client retries.
Anna (Product): Security and authorization: tool execution must check caller permissions. For Hosted API: map API token -> allowed tool list. For Dedicated/Private: allow policy webhook for decision. We need this in the spec.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Telemetry: emit events: tool_call.request, tool_call.start, tool_call.end with duration, status, tool_id, model, customer_id. Must be included at launch.
Maya (Eng-ML): On types: JSON Schema subset is good but include a typed enum for input flavor: {"input_type":"string|struct|binary"} because some tools accept base64 blobs.
Anna (Product): UX: default behavior when model asks for unknown tool = return a harmless hint + fallback text to user. No silent failures.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Edge cases: model calls tool with wrong arg types -> reject with 400-like error plus annotated validation errors: [{"path":"/foo","message":"expected int"}].
Oliver (DevEx): Example error payload for client: `{ "type":"tool_result","status":"error","error":{"code":"validation_error","message":"input validation failed","details":[{"path":"/quantity","msg":"expected integer"}]}}`
Anna (Product): Launch QA: we need 5 customer scenarios validated: payments lookup (sensitive), calendar create (idempotency), search re-rank (high QPS), image-resize (binary payload), and internal pipe (lightweight).
Maya (Eng-ML): For sensitive ops add a flag `sensitive:true` on tool manifest and require additional audit logging + HSM/KMS integration for dedicated/private.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Backwards compatibility: if tool schema changes we must support versioning: `tool_id:v2` or explicit `tool_version` field. Default to immutable versions.
Oliver (DevEx): Docs: include migration guide showing how to bump versions and sample server-side handler for retries.
Anna (Product): Prioritization matrix (quick draft): Must-haves for launch: manifest, validation, basic call/result format, telemetry, auth checks, docs + SDK examples. Stretch: streaming, chaining, version migration tooling, binary streaming, advanced retry semantics.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Timeline ask: 3 sprints for must-haves, 2 sprints for stretch. Resource ask: 1 eng-platform, 1 eng-ml, 1 devex for examples.
Maya (Eng-ML): One more note: model-side guidance. We should provide a small prompt-craft template so models emit correct `tool_call` messages instead of free-form. Add that to docs.
Anna (Product): OK. Action items: Sam - PR with minimal JSON schemas and example request/response frames by EOD Friday. Maya - list validator options and config knobs. Oliver - draft SDK snippets and quickstart. I'll sync with customers on the 5 scenarios.
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll post the PR and tag folks. deploy-bot: deploy check started for staging-toolspecs... :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy success to staging at 1772381258
Oliver (DevEx): :thumbsup: thanks everyone, will start examples tomorrow.
